# Scenario F regression positions

These are the exact mechanical positions from the 10 October 2026 long-game
playtest of commit `60da72b8265e4d5e797d56499dec88046a852853`. Only the past
`history` transcript has been cleared, to avoid retaining irrelevant data and
repeatedly copying it during tests. All positions, resources, pending decisions,
current RNG seed/count, and other mechanical fields are unchanged.

The manifest records SHA-256 for the original evidence and compact fixtures.
Tests assert corrected behavior, not the old results. In particular, Arezzo at
Cortona was not eligible for the Allies extra Muster: that invalid choice is
now rejected, while the eligible Commander at Firenze can take the segment.
